verdict.rationale: Convex documents ACID transactions and fully transactional server-side mutations. Queries are written as TypeScript running in the database, with optional schemas to enforce document shape and indexes for fast querying. Nothing in the pack documents joins or relational constraints beyond schema shape validation, so only the transactions part of the story is clearly delivered. missing for 10: documented join support, relational constraints (foreign keys, uniqueness), independent or hands-on corroboration of relational querying
